curation.notes: Mainly a DNA origami design/assembly paper (AFM imaging for yield); the SMFS part is custom dual-trap optical tweezers unfolding of three triangle origami scaffold variants (T1-T3) ligated between 2 kbp dsDNA handles, with a long DNA hairpin unzipping control. Unfolding curves: nT1=30, nT2=33, nT3=42. The Cypher ES / JPK AFMs were used for imaging only, not force spectroscopy.

evidence.snippet: Data were digitised at a 2500 Hz sampling rate and saved to disk, with all subsequent data processing performed in MATLAB (MathWorks).

filter_frequency.note: post-acquisition low-pass filter applied for the non-uniformity metric analysis

evidence.snippet: For each pair, we low-pass filtered the data to 10 Hz.

bead_size.note: anti-digoxigenin bead 0.8 um; streptavidin bead 0.9 um

evidence.snippet: The full construct (handles + origami structure) was incubated for 15 minutes on ice with 0.8 μm polystyrene beads (Spherotech) coated with anti-digoxigenin antibodies.

attachment_chemistry: ligation of handle overhangs to origami scaffold staples

handle_sequences.annotations: We generated two 2000 bp DNA handles, each uniquely tagged with double digoxigenin or biotin, by performing PCR on bacteriophage lambda DNA.

entities.name: Triangle DNA origami variants T1, T2, T3 (custom scaffold sequences)

evidence.snippet: triangle origamis were prepared using the fast ramp annealing protocol described above but with two modified staples extending from the 5’ and 3’ ends of the scaffold (Methods).

entities.name: dsDNA handles (2000 bp, lambda DNA PCR, digoxigenin- or biotin-tagged)

evidence.snippet: We generated two 2000 bp DNA handles, each uniquely tagged with double digoxigenin or biotin, by performing PCR on bacteriophage lambda DNA.
